meta.title: Inquirdi - build a survey, collect answers
meta.description: Build a survey, share one link, read the results. In Estonian, English and Russian.

hero.note: This is Inquirdi's real answering view. Your answer stays in this browser, we do not store it. The other responses are demonstration data.
hero.statement: Build a survey. Share one link. Read the results.

demo.title: How do you collect feedback today?

turn.title: This is what the survey's owner sees.
turn.body: The same answer, two ways. Neither needed setting up.

scale.title: One answer is an opinion. Three hundred is a result.
scale.body: Inquirdi aggregates them for you: the distribution, the average, and the point where people gave up. No spreadsheet required.
scale.demoQuestion: How satisfied are you with the service? (2026)

waves.title: Ask again next year.
waves.body: A recurring survey is a wave. You match the questions across waves yourself. Inquirdi never guesses a match, because a wrong one is worse than a missing one.
waves.demoQuestion: How satisfied are you with the service?

languages.title: One link, three languages.
languages.body: Write the survey in one language and translate it into the others. The respondent picks theirs; the link you share stays the same.

close.title: Build your first survey.
close.body: No password needed, we send a sign-in link by email.
